content:
My OC training just got over and I honestly didn't expect to feel this way about it.

Going in, I'd always describe myself as an introvert. Not really someone who talks much or puts themselves out there in a room full of new people.

But something about these few days changed that. The faculties who came in, the sessions, just being around so many people constantly, it slowly pulled something out of me. I found myself talking more, meeting people, actually making connections instead of just sitting back and observing like I usually do.

By the end of it I genuinely felt like a different version of myself. More open, more okay with putting myself out there.

These were honestly some of the best days I've had in a while. Learned a lot, but more than that, I think I learned something about myself that I didn't know before.

Funny how a training that's supposed to teach you work related stuff ends up teaching you something completely different about who you are.
Shivangi Aggarwal Mam
The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
#icai #oc #gurugrambranch
comment: Professional growth often happens in unexpected spaces. The ability to build relationships and communicate confidently becomes as important as technical knowledge in shaping a long-term career.
